title: Fee Waivers and Refunds on CareLine Service Plans Charges
content:
**Billing desk standard — credits on CareLine Service Plans charges.**

A fee waiver reverses one specific charge in full when the records show it was not owed under these terms, such as a trip fee on a visit that should have used a free trip, or a no-show fee on a visit Ridgeline itself rescheduled. A charge is waived or refunded at most once. Charges correctly assessed are not waived by support as a courtesy.

### Scope

The service charges of a plan are the amounts billed to the plan holder — plan fees, trip fees, labor, parts, surcharges and no-show fees — net of credits, waivers and refunds. A credit is one of two kinds: a fee waiver, or a cancellation refund of a plan fee. Each credit names the one charge it concerns.

### Elements of a fee waiver

| Element | Standard |
|---|---|
| Object | One specific charge, named by the waiver |
| Amount | That charge in full |
| Ground | The records show the charge was not owed under these terms |
| Limit | A charge is waived or refunded at most once: a charge that already has a fee waiver or a cancellation refund on record naming it is not credited again |
| Authority | The company's records of the charge and of any credit already naming it |
| Not a ground | Courtesy: a charge correctly assessed is not waived |

### Illustrations (hypothetical charges)

1. A trip fee was billed on a repair visit, and the records show that the visit should have used a free trip. The trip fee was not owed; a fee waiver reverses it in full.
2. A no-show fee was billed for a visit that Ridgeline itself rescheduled. The fee was not owed; a fee waiver reverses it in full.
3. A trip fee correctly billed on a repair visit with no free trip remaining. The charge was owed; it is not waived as a courtesy.
4. A no-show fee already reversed by a fee waiver. A second waiver naming the same charge is not issued: a charge is waived or refunded at most once.
